item.title: Taylor Fresh Foods Inc: Pineapple Mango Salsa Mild. Recall
item.summary: Potential contamination with Salmonella. Product details: Pineapple Mango Salsa Mild. Ingredients: Mango, Pineapple, Pasteurized Lime Juice, Pasteurized Lemon Juice, Jalapeno Pepper, Serrano Pepper, Lime Flavored Zest (***), Lemon Peel (***), Spearmint, Salt. Net Wt: 10 oz. Keep Refrigerated. Distributed By: Taylor F...
item.affectedPeople: Domestic: AL, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NE, NH, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, VT, WI, WV. Foreign: Not applicable.
item.remedy: Affected quantity: Illinois: 1,056 units; Texas: 1,440 units
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
